benefits: Read scripts smoothly on camera without looking away.
Adjustable scroll speed matches your natural speaking pace.
Large, high-contrast text readable from across the room.
Mirror-flip mode works with real teleprompter glass rigs.
Free forever — no app install, works on any device.

faqs.a: Paste your script, press Start, then press Play. The text scrolls upward automatically — adjust the speed slider until it matches your speaking pace.
faqs.q: How do I use the teleprompter?

faqs.a: Drag the speed slider from 1 (slowest) to 10 (fastest). Start slower than you think — most beginners read faster on camera than they expect.
faqs.q: How do I set the right scroll speed?

faqs.a: Mirror flip horizontally mirrors the text so it reads correctly when reflected in teleprompter glass placed in front of your camera lens.
The A+ and A- buttons change the text size from 16px to 72px, so you can read from any distance.
faqs.q: Can I change the text size?

faqs.a: Yes — scrolling stops automatically at the end of the script.
faqs.q: Does it stop at the end?

faqs.a: Not currently. The script stays in the page while it is open; copy it elsewhere if you need to keep it.

teleprompter.formula:
scrollStep = speed pixels every 50 ms
scroll speed (px/sec) = speed x 20
scrolling stops when scrollTop + clientHeight >= scrollHeight
howTo: Paste your full script into the text box.
Check the word count, then press Start.
Press Play and read as the text scrolls.
Adjust the speed slider until it matches your speaking pace.
Use A+/A- for text size and mirror flip for teleprompter glass.
keyFacts: The prompter scrolls your script upward at a steady, adjustable speed.
Speed ranges from 1 (about 20 px/sec) to 10 (about 200 px/sec).
Scrolling stops automatically when the end of the script is reached.
Text size can be set from 16px to 72px for any reading distance.
Mirror flip reverses the text horizontally for glass rigs.
teleprompter.keywords: teleprompter online, free teleprompter, auto scrolling script reader, video script prompter, speech teleprompter

labels.speedHint: Speed 1 is slowest, 10 is fastest. The prompter stops automatically at the end.

limitations: The script is not saved — keep a copy elsewhere if you need it.
No voice control or auto-pacing from your speech.
Scrolling is time-based, so it cannot pause at natural speech pauses.

teleprompter.quickAnswer: An auto-scrolling script reader for videos, speeches and presentations: paste your script, press start, and read as the text scrolls upward at your pace. Adjustable scroll speed (1–10), resizable text (16–72px), high-contrast display, and a mirror-flip mode for real teleprompter glass rigs — all in the browser, no install.
teleprompter.tagline: Read scripts on camera like a pro — auto-scroll, speed and mirror flip.
